insights.one_liner: DEGIRO is the Amsterdam-founded online broker, now part of flatexDEGIRO, an IND recognised sponsor with English-language roles in Amsterdam.

culture.text: Part of flatexDEGIRO, which runs an online brokerage platform in Europe built on its own in-house technology.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (flatex DEGIRO Bank Dutch Branch).

growth.text: flatexDEGIRO raised its outlook after a strong second quarter of 2026.
flatexDEGIRO says it is setting course for its next phase of growth.

worth_knowing.text: DEGIRO launched a 'Box 2 Beleggen' investing product, responding to uncertainty over Dutch box 3 tax rules.
